description: An open announcement from a funder (government agency, foundation, charity, or university) inviting researchers to submit a research proposal by a stated deadline for a defined amount of money; it excludes grants already awarded, sample proposals, news coverage about funding, and grant-writing advice.
confusables: past or awarded grants and recipient lists
news and blog posts about research funding
closed or expired calls with no current deadline
examples: Horizon Europe Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Postdoctoral Fellowships 2025
Wellcome Trust Discovery Awards - Open Call

fields.name: title
fields.description: Headline name of the call as shown on its listing page, often including the programme acronym and year.

fields.name: funder
fields.description: Name of the organisation issuing the call, usually displayed as a link or logo caption near the title.

fields.name: deadline
fields.description: Final submission deadline for proposals, typically shown as a calendar date with optional time and timezone.

fields.name: opening_date
fields.description: Date the call opened or will open for submissions, often listed above the deadline.

fields.name: funding_amount
fields.description: Maximum or total funding available per award, usually shown with a currency symbol or ISO code (e.g., $, €, £, USD).

fields.name: eligibility
fields.description: Who can apply, often a short paragraph or bullet list covering career stage, nationality, and discipline.
fields.example: Early-career researchers within 7 years of PhD, any nationality, all disciplines.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Short summary or abstract of the call, usually the first long paragraph on the page.
fields.example: Supports graduate students pursuing research-based master's and doctoral degrees in STEM fields.

fields.name: guidelines_url
fields.description: Link to the official call document, guidelines PDF, or full programme page.

fields.name: programme_type
fields.description: Category of the call such as Fellowship, Grant, Prize, or Contract, sometimes shown as a tag.
